subject: Medexa integration: technical summary and proposed PoC for streaming + embeddings/rerank
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medexa.com>, Tom Wu <tom.wu@medexa.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 09:10:00 -0800
Subject: Recap & proposed PoC — streaming + embeddings/rerank

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for taking time this morning to walk through Medexa's clinical search and summarization flow. Below is a short recap of what we heard, what we'd propose for a tightly scoped PoC, and concrete next steps. I tried to be conservative on scope so we can prove value quickly.

Summary of pain points you shared
- Real-time summarization latency exceeding SLA during peak hours (esp. when pulling long chart notes).
- Search returns too many low-relevance results — need reranking and a domain-tuned embedding index.
- Need structured outputs (JSON) for downstream EHR actions and to avoid post-processing errors.
- Security: HIPAA controls, audit logs, and clear evidence for SOC 2.

What Redwood can deliver in the PoC (proposed)
1) Two-endpoint PoC (2 weeks):
   - Streaming summarization endpoint (stream tokens back to client) to validate latency improvement and progressive UI rendering.
   - Embedding + rerank pipeline in a staging index: ingest ~10k records, compare current ranker vs Redwood rerank.
2) SDK/API requirements:
   - Function-calling hooks for structured outputs (we'll deliver a sample function schema for EHR actions).
   - Streaming SDK snippet (JS + Python) that preserves partial JSON emits and graceful resumption if a socket drops.   
3) Success metrics: 90th-percentile token latency < 350ms for 512-token context in staging; 20%+ relative improvement in NDCG@10 for rerank set.
4) Security/compliance:
   - We can run the PoC on Redwood Hosted or Redwood Private (VPC) depending on procurement and SOC 2 constraints.
   - Attached: high-level SOC 2 summary and our integration checklist.

Proposed timeline & owners
- Week 0 (this week): Confirm scope and data access (owners: Elena, Tom) — target: 11/18
- Week 1: SDK + sample function schema delivered by Redwood (owner: Neha) — target: 11/22
- Week 2: Ingest sample dataset and run initial rerank comparison (owner: Ben) — target: 11/29
- Week 3: Streaming latency validation & joint demo (owners: Ben, Priyom) — target: 12/06

Attachments included with this message: medexa_poc_scope.xlsx (high-level scope), redwood-sdk-integration-plan.md (dev steps), soc2-summary.pdf (controls summary).

Immediate asks for Medexa
- Access: a sanitized sample export (10k rows) or S3 read credentials to a designated test bucket.
- Security contact for evidence collection (SOC2 + architecture) — cc Alicia if appropriate.
- Procurement contact for Private deployment pricing if you want a VPC path.

If that all looks right I'll schedule a 30-min technical kickoff next week with Ben and Priyom.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-sdk-integration-plan.md (text/markdown)]
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@medexa.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Wu <tom.wu@medexa.com>, Alicia Gomez <alicia.gomez@medexa.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Recap & proposed PoC — streaming + embeddings/rerank

Thanks Neha — this is very helpful and matches our notes. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Security: Alicia Gomez (cc'd) is our security lead; she'll need the SOC 2 artifact and an architectural diagram showing where PHI lives during the PoC. We may require Private deployment depending on the legal review.
2) Data: We can produce a sanitized 10k export but it will be in S3 (us-east-1). I'll ask infra to grant a read-only role; ETA 11/19.
3) Success criteria: in addition to latency and NDCG, we want to track "structured parse accuracy" for the function outputs — target > 95% for mandatory fields.

Tom will own procurement conversations (Tom Wu) and will loop legal.

Proposed: Technical kickoff on 11/22 afternoon ET.

- If you need private deployment for the PoC, we'll stand up a VPC-based sandbox; cost estimate (for a 2-week PoC) is in the attached XLSX. If procurement prefers hosted for the PoC, we can proceed there with a tighter data-handling plan.
- Ben will lead ingestion and the rerank baseline comparison — Ben will reach out with the exact S3 path and ingestion manifest format.

I've attached the integration plan and SOC 2 summary again here. Also linking the HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/123456789/medx-2026-1143 (same as above).

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.
